speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. These symptoms suggest a systemic issue; have you noticed any lumps in your neck or armpits, or any changes in your bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those symptoms combined with the lymph node enlargement are concerning for a systemic malignancy like lymphoma. Have you experienced any difficulty swallowing, fever, or a persistent cough? Also, do you have a history of smoking or recent significant stress?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.
